Quick technical notes based on Amy's numbers:
- Recommendation: start with 10x A100-equivalent slots (we estimate this maps to ~8 A100-80GB or 6 H100-80GB with quantization/kv cache). Given 420 rps 95th and 600 burst concurrency target, the safety margin should be ~1.3x of calculated steady-state to allow for autoscaling headroom.
- Canary plan: 10% -> 30% -> 70% over three validation windows (each 30–60min) with live request tracing enabled and token-level perf logging.
- Validation checks: throughput plateau, tail-latency guardrails, cold-start P50/P95, and model-fallback correctness (same prompts with fallback model must produce regression score within 0.02 of baseline).
- KV cache warmup: pre-populate most common prefixes for clinician flows; expect 8–12 hours to reach steady cache hit rates after replay.
- Rollback triggers: p95 > 600ms for 10m sustained OR error-rate > 1.2% OR regression_score_drop > 0.03.

I’ll prepare a short smoke-test harness and can run a staging dry-run on 24 May if Epoch can mirror 10% of steady traffic. Also need platform/network: please confirm we have these firewall rules open for the dedicated VPC peering (I'll paste required CIDRs in the shared runbook).

Karthik

Amy / Carlos — thanks for the quick turnaround. Attaching an updated Mutual Action Plan (v2) and a short runbook. Key items summarized here so the wider engineering and procurement teams have clear boundaries.

Mutual Action Plan highlights:
- PO target: procurement to route PO by 20 May; DocuSign SOW link below will reflect final numbers (Ben: please confirm order amount once your discount/credits are applied).
- Preflight (21–23 May): security questionnaire resolved, VPC peering validated, egress rules opened, and test accounts created.
- Staged validation (24–25 May): run traffic replay at 10%/30%/70% with 30–60m holds. Redwood will run smoke tests and capture perf traces.
- Dry run & fallback (26 May): full dry-run with rollback window; if issues found, we push to backup weekend 3–4 Jun.
- Cutover (27 May 00:00 UTC start): final DNS/traffic flip; Redwood on-call to monitor; CS/SE/Network all paged.

Cutover runbook (top-level):
- T-24h: final snapshot and cache pre-warm kickoff.
- T-2h: canary groups enabled at 10%; monitoring dashboards verified.
- T+30m: increase to 30% if health checks pass.
- T+90m: move to 70% then 100% by T+6h if all green.
- Rollback plan: immediate rollback to hosted API endpoint with traffic diversion and customer alert template (we'll own the DNS rollback).

Acceptance criteria (must be green to proceed):
1) p95 latency < 500ms across clinical flow suites for 60m.
2) error-rate < 0.5% sustained.
3) regression score within 0.02 of baseline for 100 sampled prompts.
